decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting line fits the firm's specialist, standards-heavy marine offering and, given long sales cycles and low option-holding cost after surviving into 2024, management would likely keep it open.

As a general interior luminaire it is close to the core business but less distinctive and seemingly less emphasized by 2024, so management would keep it for now while assigning a higher rationalization risk than the more strategic lines.
Because the firm presents this pendant luminaire as a flagship direction and still highlights it in 2024, its option value appears high and management would strongly favor continuation.
This marine searchlight remains on the market after the related HMI searchlight was removed, suggesting it is the stronger marine search option and worth retaining despite its niche market.
